transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I came in because... well, I've been having these episodes where I eat a lot, and afterward, I just feel so gross and disappointed in myself. It's like I should have more control, you know? It gets so bad that I end up writing some really awful things about myself in my journal. I just... I want to figure out how to stop feeling this way.
After these episodes of overeating, do you do anything to try to make up for the food you ate, such as making yourself vomit, taking medications, or exercising intensely?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't make myself throw up or take any kind of pills. And I don't really exercise much, either... I'm on my feet cleaning buildings all day for work, so I'm usually way too tired to work out. I just kind of... sit there and feel terrible about what I just did.
During these times when you eat a lot, do you feel like you can't stop eating or can't control how much you're eating?

Yeah, that is exactly how it feels. Once I start, it's like... I just keep reaching for the next thing almost automatically. Even while I'm sitting there thinking to myself, Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish, I don't actually stop. I just keep going until all the food is gone, or I feel too uncomfortable to eat anymore.
On average, how often do these eating episodes happen in a week?

Well, for the past several months, it's been happening about once a week. Usually, there's at least one night where I stop after work, buy way too much food, and just eat it all in one sitting. I honestly can't remember a recent month where I went more than a week or so without doing it.
